rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a heated verbal quarrel.

example.english: I don't want to quarrel with you at someone else's wedding.
example.traditional: 我唔想同你喺人哋婚禮度嗌交。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 hai2 jan4 dei6 fan1 lai5 dou6 aai3 gaau1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for two or more people arguing or falling out.

example.english: We quarrel over little things all the time.
example.traditional: 我哋兩兄弟成日為咗啲小事嗌交。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 seng4 jat6 wai6 zo2 di1 siu2 si6 aai3 gaau1

rows.note: Use this for the act of arguing, especially when focusing on the verbal dispute itself rather than the relationship breaking down.

example.english: Don't quarrel with him; just explain things clearly.
example.traditional: 你唔好同佢詏啦，講清楚就算。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 aau3 laa1 gong2 cing1 co2 zau6 syun3

rows.note: Use this when the quarrel is notably noisy or involves loud bickering.

example.english: The two people upstairs quarrel so loudly that I can't sleep.
example.traditional: 樓上兩個人嘈交嘈到我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: lau4 soeng6 loeng5 go3 jan4 cou4 gaau1 cou4 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this for a complaint, objection, or disagreement with someone rather than an actual argument.

example.english: I have a quarrel with this arrangement and want to discuss it with you.
example.traditional: 我對呢個安排有意見，想同你傾吓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 jau5 ji3 gin3 soeng2 tung4 nei5 king1 haa5

rows.note: Use this for lingering ill feeling or a grudge resulting from a dispute.

example.english: After making up years later, they no longer have any quarrel between them.
example.traditional: 佢哋多年後重修舊好，彼此之間已經冇晒芥蒂。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 do1 nin4 hau6 cung4 sau1 gau6 hou2 bei2 ci2 zi1 gaan1 ji5 ging1 mou5 saai3 gaai3 dai3
